Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer:
Multi-factor authentication is a security measure that requires two or more credentials for verification. This adds an extra layer of security to an account. Two-factor authentication (2FA) is an example of multi-factor authentication, where a user is typically required to provide a password and a verification code sent to their phone or generated by an authenticator app. The additional factor makes it harder for unauthorized users to gain access to the account.

The document about Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) mentions two factors, but it is not directly related to multi-factor authentication. However, it does provide some background on the concept of multiple factors in a broader context.
